messages:
incident-bot: Pagerduty alert -> HIGH: region-health-oscillation detected between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Smart routing fallback policy 'multi-region-prefer' is flip-flopping; we see continuous failover loops for ~6m. Immediate customer impact: increased tail latency (p95 up ~600ms) and transient 502/504s for some Dedicated tenants. Auto-fallbacks counted: 3k -> 7k -> 2k in last windows. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/region-fallback-loop :rotating_light:
alyssa: acknowledged. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now — which customers exactly? any VIPs in the mix?@support-lead
samir: I see tenant_ids: rwd-prod-42, partner-dl-9 in the logs. both on dedicated capacity in us-east but traffic is bouncing. Looks like health checks from eu instances are flapping and causing routing to prefer us-west, then us-east, then back.
mei: paging @alyssa @samir — i've notified support to prepare outbound for the two affected customers. ETA for a mitigation?
alyssa: triage notes: metrics point to health-check TTL=3s on eu pool combined with aggressive failover window (2 probes). we should increase debounce and temporarily pin routing for those tenants to their home region to stop oscillation. Also looking at circuit-breaker misfires flagged in the logs.
infra-sre: quick dump of the recent probe log (trimmed):
```
2026-03-14T22:03:12Z eu-probe: health=OK latency=22ms seq=120
2026-03-14T22:03:15Z eu-probe: health=FAIL error="504 backend" seq=121
2026-03-14T22:03:17Z us-west-probe: health=OK latency=18ms seq=87
2026-03-14T22:03:18Z eu-probe: health=OK latency=21ms seq=122
2026-03-14T22:03:20Z us-east-probe: health=DEGRADED latency=400ms seq=301
```
Looks like short-lived 504s plus a slow us-east downstream spike.
samir: mitigation plan (short): 1) increase health probe debounce for eu pool from 2->5 (temporarily), 2) set per-tenant routing override to prefer us-east (pin) for rwd-prod-42 and partner-dl-9, 3) reduce automatic fallback aggressiveness: bump fallback-window from 10s->30s, 4) monitor for 10m then revert graceful.
alyssa: agreed. I'll run the override now for the two tenants and adjust debounce. executing: 
```bash
# increase debounce on eu probe (temporary)
rdwctl config set region.eu.probe.debounce 5 --reason "mitigate probe flap"
# pin routing for affected tenants
rdwctl routing override create --tenant rwd-prod-42 --region us-east --ttl 600 --note "mitigate fallback loop"
rdwctl routing override create --tenant partner-dl-9 --region us-east --ttl 600 --note "mitigate fallback loop"
```
pagerduty: Alyssa acknowledged the page (on-call). Incident priority: P1 -> escalation to SRE lead if not resolved in 15m.
support-lead: support outbound draft queued. going to call rwd-prod-42 PM and let partner-dl-9 ops know about temporary pin.
infra-sre: applied probe debounce change and verified config. response from api: `{\"status\":\"ok\",\"applied\":true}`
alyssa: overrides applied, got same confirmation. Now watching routing metrics.
(2m later) samir: preliminary signals look good — oscillation count dropped to zero over the last 60s, 5xx rate trending down. p95 latency for affected tenants dropping back toward baseline.
mei: support on call reported customers acknowledged the outage and appreciate the quick mitigation.
alyssa: leaving the overrides for 30m. next steps: postmortem and root-cause. initial hypothesis: eu health-check sensitivity combined with transient backend 504s triggered a cascading fallback because routing policy used probe count+fast-fail thresholds too low. Also need to check model-variant compatibility check that occasionally marks nodes unhealthy when KV cache pressure is high.
samir: action items captured: [A] revert probe debounce to default after 30m if stable, [B] add canary smoothing (increase default probe_debounce to 4 in auto-rollout), [C] add a guard in smart-router to require 2 consecutive probing windows before full region failover for Dedicated tenants, [D] add more granular telemetry on variant-mismatch vs network 504s. I'll create the follow-up tickets.
infra-sre: runbook note: consider adding an automated temporary pin when oscillation rate > X for Y minutes instead of immediate full failover.
incident-bot: Incident status update -> MITIGATED (manual mitigations applied). Keeping thread open for postmortem notes and follow-up. Incident start: 3420012345; mitigated at 3420012671.
alyssa: adding short postmortem draft to /docs/incidents/3420012345-postmortem.md and flagging for next-week RCA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
support-lead: closing the customer communications loop after postmortem is published.
mei: leaving observability watch for 45m, will update if anything creeps back.
alyssa: final: system stable for 20m, keeping open for audit. if no regression, i'll close in 1h and file the tickets.
incident-bot: Closing note -> follow-up tickets: RDW-3251 (probe debounce tuning), RDW-3252 (router failover hysteresis), RDW-3253 (variant health telemetry).
